== Summary ==
Slip “•Critical Error Revealed” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 1603, 1102, 1887)). Version [[Critical Error Revealed (V)|Critical Error Revealed (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
